prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. HD game color diffuse texture, edit existing painted UV image, preserve its exact artwork.

Image1 is the ENTIRE original opaque native storedRGB 128x128 edit target. Output entire same aspect 128:128 canvas and normalized UV. Original fullalpha restored separately; keep all storedRGB including black authoredpaint. No margin/padding/crop/zoom/island registration/rotation, no layouts shifted.

This is an UPSIDE-DOWN STORED FACE UV diffuse texture, not a portrait. Preserve the exact current orientation and whole square canvas. The single existing male face stays upside down in the lower-center region, with the very same identity, hair color, age, expression, pale eye marks, nose, short closed mouth mark, ear outlines and diffuse cheek shading. Preserve the existing jagged three-part brown hair silhouette along the bottom edge. Preserve the separate ear and FOUR-band hand paint islands along the top edge and the exact black gaps; never assemble them into a new person or rearrange the atlas. Keep the original restrained old game PAINTED shading. Add only delicate painted definition to existing features, without photographic pores, eyelashes, new teeth, beard hairs, bright eye whites, new expression or anatomy. Keep weak facial details weak and the mouth closed; do not mirror, rotate or beautify the face. The source tiny islands and clipped borders remain clipped.

Keep original muted filtered hand-painted appearance, source brush softness, palette, relative local lightstrength and native scale. Add only subtle fine painted information following EXISTING forms. Do not invent photographic weave, fibers, stipple, pores, metalgrain, raised rims, etching, shiny chrome, brighter white edges, new seams/buttons/straps/hardware, emblems or lettering. Preserve every existing dark gap, small mark, fold, count and phase. Do not brighten or sharpen weak diffuse washes into new structures. Increase resolution to four-times native dimensions while preserving source material and softness. No background texture added, no extraneous objects.
review_concern: Exact whole selected-native RGBA, dimensions, UV canvas, native type and actual material Alpha/AddressMode match reviewed donor. One existing donor generation reused, no new call. Native4x brightness/full A expected identical; target original aliases and previous history preserved.
